preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.
The number of special offers m is between 0 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(1 <= x <= 10**12 for x in a)
preconditions.description: The list a contains exactly n integers, each between 1 and 10^12 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(offers) == m and all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y and 1 <= w <= 10**12 for (x, y, w) in offers)
preconditions.description: The list of offers contains exactly m tuples (x, y, w) where x and y are distinct vertices in [1, n] and w is between 1 and 10^12.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(min_cost, int) and min_cost == min_spanning_tree_weight(n, a, offers)
postconditions.description: The output is an integer representing the minimum cost to make the graph connected, which equals the weight of the Minimum Spanning Tree (MST) of the complete graph where edge weights are min(a[x-1] + a[y-1], special_offer_weight) for all pairs.
